parsed.post: Discarding my 0.839735 result. It was heavily contaminated by training on EVAL_SHARD 10. Following the team consensus, I am reverting to the last valid state and re-baselining on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'. This will be a much higher (but honest) BPB.
parsed.description: Re-baselining on clean shards 0-9 to establish a valid performance floor after data leakage was identified.
